name: dojun_project_app
postCreateCommand: apk add --no-cache git mysql-client openssh-client && if [ ! -f /workspace/package.json ]; then git clone git@github.com:dojunshin/fullstack_project.git /tmp/repo && cp -r /tmp/repo/. /workspace/ && rm -rf /tmp/repo; fi && cd /workspace && npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && (mysql -h mysql -uroot -prootpass test < /workspace/server/sql/products.mysql.sql 2>/dev/null || true)
